title: Folk psychology is not discarded before a successor can carry its explanatory load

statements.text: If folk psychology is muddled, it is not clear how it should be revised or what will replace it. There is no question of discarding it until a suitable theory can take over the explanatory burden, since even a misconceived theory is better than none, and folk psychology and its successors are part of the co-evolution.

sources.quote: Certainly there is no question of discarding folk psychology until there is a suitable theory to take over the explanatory burden.
Even a misconceived theory is better than no theory at all.
